claims.text: The root cause of suffering is the identification with self-image—when our sense of who we are gets hurt or threatened.
Sri Preethaji and Sri Krishnaji teach that we often blame external circumstances, but the real pain comes from clinging to how we see ourselves.
Every human oscillates between two states: the Suffering State (marked by division, fear, and separation) and the Beautiful State (where calm, joy, and connection arise naturally).
The shift happens when we recognize consciousness as the force behind our experience, moving from external seeking to inner unity.

The only remedy is to awaken to Oneness consciousness—a state of profound interconnectedness where the illusion of separation dissolves. This shift in awareness transforms our perception of reality, replacing fear and fragmentation with love and unity. By embracing this awakening, individuals can heal their lives and contribute to a more harmonious world, demonstrating that true transformation begins within the consciousness itself.
